scholarships.title: TDTU Scholarship for International Students (2026-2027 Academic Year)

existing.description: Ton Duc Thang University publishes an annual TDTU Scholarship scheme for international undergraduate applicants, with awards ranging from partial to full depending on academic performance and language proficiency. Under the full scholarship a holder pays no undergraduate tuition fee and no dormitory fee; under the partial scholarship the tuition fee is 50-75% covered and the dormitory fee is still fully covered. A separate set of monthly living-allowance scholarships (5 full awards of VND 4,000,000 per month and 20 partial awards of VND 2,500,000 per month) is available to students enrolling in Vietnamese-taught programmes at the university's Khanh Hoa branch. Applications for the January 2027 semester are open until 20 October 2026.
eligibility: High school diploma or equivalent, with graduation time in 2027, 2026 or 2025
Average high school study GPA or average high school graduation exam GPA of at least 5.0/10
For English-taught undergraduate programmes: citizen of an English-native-speaking country, or a valid IELTS score of at least 5.5 (or an equivalent accepted certificate)

For Vietnamese-taught undergraduate programmes: a Vietnamese language proficiency test result or certificate at B2 level or above, or one year of Vietnamese language study at TDTU followed by passing TDTU's Vietnamese proficiency test at B2 or above

Applicants from Myanmar: the high school transcript is strictly required, not the matriculation examination result; the matriculation result is accepted only with a confirmation form signed and stamped by the local authority or Department of Education
For the Pharmacy major: final-year senior high school GPA marked 'Good' or above, and an average Chemistry score of at least 7.0/10.0
For Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design: must take TDTU's aptitude assessment test before entering the Bachelor's programme
Must be officially admitted by Ton Duc Thang University and satisfy all scholarship maintenance requirements throughout their studies
existing.eligibility_summary: International applicants with a high school diploma or equivalent (graduation in 2027, 2026 or 2025) and a high school average of at least 5.0/10, plus English at IELTS 5.5 or equivalent for English-taught programmes (or citizenship of an English-speaking country) and Vietnamese at B2 for Vietnamese-taught programmes. Applicants must also be officially admitted by Ton Duc Thang University and satisfy the scholarship maintenance requirements throughout their studies.
benefits: Full scholarship: 100% of undergraduate tuition fee (excluding tuition for any course studied for a second time)
Partial scholarship: 50-75% of undergraduate tuition fee (excluding second-time course tuition)
For Vietnamese-taught programmes: 100% of the Vietnamese language class tuition fee under both scholarship types

Monthly living allowance scholarships for the Khanh Hoa branch: 5 full awards at VND 4,000,000 per month and 20 partial awards at VND 2,500,000 per month, for students enrolling in Vietnamese-taught undergraduate programmes
coverage: Full scholarship: 100% of undergraduate tuition fee and 100% of dormitory fee
Partial scholarship: 50-75% of undergraduate tuition fee and 100% of dormitory fee
For Vietnamese-taught programmes: 100% of the Vietnamese language class tuition fee under both full and partial scholarships
Monthly living allowance scholarships at the Khanh Hoa branch: 5 full awards of VND 4,000,000 per month and 20 partial awards of VND 2,500,000 per month
requirements: Hold a high school diploma or equivalent with graduation in 2027, 2026 or 2025
Achieve an average high school GPA of at least 5.0/10
Meet the language requirement for the chosen programme (IELTS 5.5 or equivalent for English-taught programmes; Vietnamese B2 for Vietnamese-taught programmes)
Complete any subject-specific extra requirement for the chosen major (Pharmacy Chemistry score, or the TDTU aptitude assessment test for the design and architecture majors)
Be officially admitted by Ton Duc Thang University
Send scanned copies of the required documents to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application period
Maintain the retention criteria each academic year to keep the scholarship
documents: High school diploma or equivalent, or the high school transcript (strictly required for applicants from Myanmar)
High school study transcript or graduation exam result showing an average of at least 5.0/10
IELTS certificate of at least 5.5 or an accepted equivalent, for English-taught programmes (or proof of citizenship of an English-native-speaking country)
Vietnamese language proficiency certificate at B2 level or above, or TDTU Vietnamese proficiency test result, for Vietnamese-taught programmes
Matriculation confirmation form signed and stamped by the local authority or Department of Education, where a matriculation result is used instead of a high school transcript
TDTU aptitude assessment test result for Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design and Industrial Design
Scanned copies of all required documents, sent to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn - TDTU states that an application is only considered valid when sufficient and correct documents are submitted
existing.english_requirement: IELTS of at least 5.5 (or an accepted equivalent) for undergraduate programmes taught in English; applicants who are citizens of an English-native-speaking country satisfy this requirement without a test
application_method: Follow the TDTU undergraduate admissions timeline for the target semester
Prepare the documents listed on the university's application form and documents page
Send scanned copies of the documents to admission.undergraduate@tdtu.edu.vn within the application period
Await the result, which is notified to eligible applicants by email (late November for the January 2027 semester)
Respond within 14 days of receiving the result notification, because TDTU states the scholarship result is terminated and transferred to other applicants if there is no response
existing.selection_notes: TDTU states that the International Admission Council will select the applicants with the highest academic performances to offer the scholarships, and that the level of award (partial or full) depends on the applicant's academic performance and language proficiency performance. The scholarship is reviewed annually on academic performance under the university's regulations, and is renewed each academic year if the retention criteria are met: a previous-year GPA of not below 6.0 for English-taught undergraduate study (not below 5.0, plus passing the Vietnamese proficiency language class at B2 level, for Vietnamese-taught study).
existing.best_fit: International high school graduates from 2025, 2026 or 2027 applying to Ton Duc Thang University's English-taught or Vietnamese-taught undergraduate programmes, especially applicants to the Pharmacy, Architecture, Graphic Design, Interior Design, Fashion Design or Industrial Design majors, and Vietnamese-taught applicants at the Khanh Hoa branch seeking a monthly living allowance.
existing.notes: The scholarship is published as a percentage of fees rather than a single monetary amount, so funding_amount is left null. The only monetary figures TDTU publishes for the 2026-2027 year are the Khanh Hoa branch monthly living allowance tiers: VND 4,000,000 per month for 5 full scholarships and VND 2,500,000 per month for 20 partial scholarships. Tuition for any course a student studies for a second time is explicitly excluded from the fee coverage, as is the Vietnamese language class tuition when a student repeats that class.
existing.duration: 04-05 years for undergraduate programmes taught in English, according to the major; 1 compulsory year of Vietnamese language study followed by 04-05 years for programmes taught in Vietnamese
existing.application_period: Open now for the January 2027 semester: applications open from 25 August to 20 October 2026, with eligible applicants notified by email in late November 2026. The September 2026 semester window has closed (15 April to 15 July 2026, results in late August 2026).
existing.deadline_display: 20 October 2026 for the January 2027 semester (application open 25 August to 20 October 2026)
existing.program_type: University-funded admission scholarship (tuition waiver and dormitory fee)
